modmenu.description.tessera: Native BC7 GPU texture compression and VRAM optimization engine.
tessera.configuration.cache.tooltip: Configure disk cache location for compiled BC7 texture blocks.
tessera.configuration.cacheDirectory.too: Folder name where compiled BC7 texture blocks are stored on disk.
tessera.configuration.compressAnimatedAt: Also compress atlases with animated textures, such as the block atlas: each frame is encoded once. Off keeps them RGBA8888. Ignored while Kerria is installed.
tessera.configuration.compressGuiAtlas.t: EXPERIMENTAL: also compresses the GUI atlas (icons, hotbar, crosshair), about 1 MB in vanilla and much more with large resource packs. Transparent texels are written to decode as exactly zero so the crosshair stays clean; a few edges of icons may lose some colour detail. BC formats only.
tessera.configuration.compression.toolti: Configure BC7 native compression behavior and animation freezing.
tessera.configuration.compressionQuality: BC7 quality preset (0: Fastest to 7: Highest Fidelity). Controls compression quality vs processing time.
tessera.configuration.debug.tooltip: Configure debug overlay display and extended information on the F3 screen.
tessera.configuration.dedupSimilarityThr: Hamming distance (0-64) for 64-bit pHash fingerprints. Lower values are stricter when merging duplicate sprites.
tessera.configuration.deduplication.tool: Configure perceptual hashing and near-duplicate sprite merging.
tessera.configuration.disableNativeCompr: Forces vanilla RGBA atlas behavior even if BC7 native compression is supported.
tessera.configuration.gpuCompression.too: EXPERIMENTAL: encodes BC7 on the GPU instead of the CPU. Needs OpenGL 4.3 (not available on macOS). It may look worse, stutter or crash on some drivers; Tessera checks it at startup and stays on the CPU if the check fails. It also keeps animation frames in VRAM (up to 64 MB per atlas) and copies them on the GPU instead of uploading them every tick. F3 shows which one is in use.
tessera.configuration.showExtendedDebugB: Displays the expanded breakdown by atlas and by bucket on the F3 Debug Screen.
tessera.configuration.title: Tessera Settings
tessera.configuration.vramBudget.tooltip: How much VRAM Tessera may use for compressed atlases and the animation frame bank.
tessera.configuration.vramBudgetAuto.too: Sets the budget from the GPU: three quarters of its dedicated VRAM (NVIDIA) or of the free VRAM at startup (AMD). Where the driver does not say, the VRAM Budget value is used.
tessera.configuration.vramBudgetTargetMb: VRAM Tessera may use for compressed atlases and the animation frame bank. The frame bank only grows within it; an atlas over it is still compressed (vanilla would take more), with a warning in the log. Ignored while Automatic Budget is on and the GPU reports its VRAM.
